spans.s: 1. गो—द mfn. (Pāṇ. iii, 2, 3, Kāś.) giving cattle or cows, Mn. iv, 231
गो—द m. du. N. of a village, Pāṇ. i, 2, 52, Kāś.
गो—द m. g. वरणादि
गो—द m. pl. N. of a tribe, Inscr.
2. गोद m. n. the brain, L.
गो—दा f. the river commonly called गो-दावरी, Kathārṇ. (cf. अनु-गोदम्).
गो—दा॑ mfn. presenting with cattle or kine, RV.
गो—दत्त्र mfn. granting cattle (Indra), RV. viii, 21, 16.
गो—दन्त m. a cow's tooth, Suśr.
yellow orpiment, L.
a white mineral substance (apparently an earthy salt), W.
गो—दन्त mfn. having cow's teeth, Buddh.; L.
armed, armed with a coat of mail, L.
गो—दन्त m. N. of a man g. शुभ्रादि
of a Dānava,
Hariv. 12937
गो—दन्त—मणि m. a particular precious stone, Hcar. viii, 15.
गो—दम mfn. (conquering i.e.) attaining heaven and earth (Sch.), MBh. xiii, 4490 (ed. Bomb.)
गो—दरि mfn. opening the stables of the sky (Indra, cf. गोत्र-भि॑द्; ‘splitting the clouds or mountains’, Sāy.), RV. viii, 92, 11.
1. गो—दान n. gift of a cow, MBh. xiii, 3345; R. vii; PSarv.
2. गो—दा॑न , &c. see s.v.
2. गोदा॑न n. (दान, fr. √ दो ? ‘place where the hair (गो) is cut’, Ragh. iii, 33, Sch.) the side-hair, ŚBr. iii; KātyŚr.; PārGṛ.
= -मङ्गल, ĀśvGṛ.; Kauś.; ŚāṅkhGṛ.; Gobh.; Gaut.; R.
गो—दान-व्रत n. a vow taken at the Go-dāna ceremony, ĀpGṛ.
गो—˚दानीय m. N. of a Dvīpa, Lalit. xii, 186 (cf. अपर-गोदान.)
&c. See गो॑, p. 365, col. 1.
गो—दाय mfn. intending to present with cattle or cows, Pāṇ. iii, 3, 12, Kāś.
गो—दारण n. ‘opening the earth’, a plough, L.
a spade or hoe, L.
गो—दावरी f. (= -दा s.v. 1. -द) ‘granting water or kine’, N. of a river in the Dekhan, MBh. iii;
Hariv. 12826
; R. iii, vi; Ragh. &c.
&c. See ib.
गो—दावरी—तीर्थ n. N. of a Tīrtha, SkandaP.
गो—दावरी—माहात्म्य n. ‘glory of the Godāvarī’, N. of wk.
गो—दावरी—संगम m. N. of a place.
गो—दुग्ध n. = -क्षीर॑, W.
गो—दुग्धा f. the Caṇikā grass, L.
गो—दुग्ध—दा f. id., L.
गो—दु॑ह् m(nom. -धुक्)fn. (Pāṇ. iii, 2, 61) a milkman or milkmaid, cowherd, RV. i, 4, 1 and 164, 26; viii, 52, 4; AV. vii, 73, 6; Pāṇ. v, 1, 5, Kāś.
&c. See ib.
गो—दुह mfn. id., L., Sch.
गो—दोह m. (cf. गां-दोह-संने॑जन) the milking of cows, VarBṛS. vli, 6
गो—दोहम् ind. as long as the cows are being milked, Pāṇ. i, 4, 51; Pat. on
Kār. 7
गो—दोहक m. = -दु॑ह्, Kathās. lxi
गो—दोहिका f. ‘a milkman's sitting’, a particular kind of being seated, HYog.
गो—दोहन n. = ˚ह, Jain., Sch.
the time necessary for milking a cow, BhP. i, 19, 39
गो—दोहनी f. a milk-pail, Pāṇ. iii, 3, 117, Kāś.
गो—द्रव m. = -जल, L.
गोदान—मङ्गल n. a ceremony performed with the side-hair of a youth of 16 or 18 years (when he has attained puberty and shortly before marriage), R. (G) i, 73, 22.
गोदान—विधि m. id., Ragh. iii, 33.
= गौद्˚, Gobh. iii, 1, 28.
